_: Why a live step differs from the original's (track 2, step d, 2026-11-26): `original`, `rewrite` (left, with why), `harness`, or `language`. A step whose name is not here takes the case's `*`; one with neither is `unattributed`, and live.mjs counts it.

hydrated.*: original: cmdk-solid cannot be served ("Client-only API called on the server side"), so its hydrated page is a browser render; the rewrite's served <input> keeps value="" as an attribute, as Solid's server render writes a value (the same in TSX)

client.*: original: @lucide/solid writes each shape's React `key` (key=1gmf2c) as an attribute of the <path> and <circle>

hydrated.*: original: as rendered, the React `key` written as an attribute

client.key Escape: original: Escape does not close the modal dialog (onOpenChange is never called on Solid 2.0.3; Kobalte documents that Escape dismisses it); the rewrite closes it
client.*: follows from `key Escape`: the original is still open, so the trigger closes it and the close button is not there

hydrated.key Escape: original: as rendered (and it is not served: Client-only API on the server)

hydrated.*: original: hydrated, it keeps aria-describedby and `for` ids from its server render that its own rendered page does not have (ids of parts it does not render); the rewrite's hydrated page is its rendered page
original: hydrated, it keeps aria-describedby/aria-labelledby ids from its server render that its own rendered page does not have; the rewrite's hydrated page is its rendered page

client.click #t-n: harness: the slides' transform is read 60 ms into their animation, and where that falls varies from run to run (the next step, `wait 900`, agrees); not counted against either side
client.*: original: its dots do not follow a slide that is added (two dots for three slides); the rewrite shows three

hydrated.*: original: fails to hydrate ("Failed attempt to create new DOM elements during hydration", then REACTIVITY_HALTED)

client.*: rewrite, left: after the listbox closes the original keeps an active option (tc-has-active): its blur listener goes with the option's owner before the focus moves; the rewrite's onBlur sees that blur and clears it. Copying it needs the closing known inside a nested blur run

rewrite, left: no form inputs (the textarea and the hidden value inputs of form-inputs.tsx were not rewritten), and a controlled value's item indicator is never shown: the bridge reads core's presence in the pass before its effect has given core the new value (the original tracks what core delivered, use-primitive's `marks`)
